subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search fail closed when a configured SecretRef is unavailable, and should `defaults`, `env`, `normalizeCredential`, and `onUnavailableConfiguredRef` become stable public resolver capabilities?
rationale: Code and runtime proof establish that the patch works, but repository policy requires owner intent for compatibility-sensitive fallback changes and public Plugin SDK expansion.

options.title: Accept shared fail-closed contract
options.body: Land the patch because it prevents silent credential switching and removes the duplicated Ollama SecretRef policy.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep the previous upgrade behavior for unavailable configured refs even though it may use a different ambient credential.

options.title: Keep expansion private
options.body: Retain the Ollama fix while avoiding some or all of the new public resolver options.

recommendation.title: Accept shared fail-closed contract
recommendation.body: Land the patch because it prevents silent credential switching and removes the duplicated Ollama SecretRef policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The current helper, public export, and Ollama credential path all originate in this owner's recent merged feature work.
